# Synthetic case definitions

## TC-PENDING

```gherkin
Scenario: Wait for a pending renewal
  Given the user's renewal request is pending
  When the user selects Extend
  Then the client action is "wait"
  And the client does not log out
```

## TC-RETRY

```gherkin
Scenario: Retry a rejected renewal
  Given the user's renewal request failed
  When the user selects Extend
  Then the client action is "retry"
  And the client does not log out
```

# Synthetic intended behavior

Source: supplied evaluation contract. No actual business approval is represented.

A pending renewal must keep the client waiting.
A rejected renewal must permit retry without logout.
Both rules apply to base and candidate.

Definitions: [TC-PENDING](test-cases.md#tc-pending), [TC-RETRY](test-cases.md#tc-retry).
